summary: Tested the new document numbering rules (BF/DI/DP), the fiscal receipt date and the daily cash limit, on both backend and frontend. Backend: the regression suite test_iter32 passes 13/13. The new suite test_iter33_document_numbering.py passes 12/13. What works: BF 45 becomes BF-000045, and when no date is sent the receipt date defaults to today. A future date or a wrong date format is rejected with 400. A non-numeric number ('', 'abc', 'BF-45') is rejected with 400. Bon fiscal is rejected for a PJ client. The same BF is rejected on the same issue date X and accepted on a different date Y. The daily cash limit is checked on the closing date (today): a 9000 RON BF dated 2 days ago plus 1500 RON today (chitanță or BF dated yesterday) is rejected, while 1000 RON is accepted. DP 3 becomes DP-000003. A second DP 3 or DP '003' on the same day is rejected. DC keeps its automatic numbering. BF-000003 and DI-000003 can exist on the same day. FAILED: a duplicate DI on the same day is ACCEPTED (2x DI-000003 via the API, 2x DI-987654 via the UI). Frontend on desktop and at 390px: the receipt date field appears only for Bon fiscal and only for PF clients, its default is today and max is today. A past date saves and opens the print view with 'Data: <receipt date>'. The Încasări numerar list shows the receipt date. A duplicate shows the toast 'deja înregistrat în această zi', and the same number on a different date saves. A future date typed in shows the toast 'nu poate fi în viitor'. The DP form at 390px has no overflow (scrollWidth 390), saves DP-000003 and rejects the duplicate with a toast. All temporary data was removed.

critical.issue: Same-day duplicate check for DI never matches. New DI records are saved with document_issue_date='' (line 503). The duplicate $or looks for {document_issue_date: today} or {document_issue_date: {$exists: false}, date: ^today}, and neither matches '' because the field exists. Reproduced: DI-000003 was created twice on 2026-10-24 (API test), and DI-987654 twice from the UI.

minor.issue: Uniqueness is only checked with find_one before insert, and there is no unique index on (tenant_id, branch_id, doc_type, doc_number, document_issue_date). Two concurrent requests can both create the same number.
A reversed (stornat) BF/DI still blocks its number for that day. Check whether this is intended.

The range register and its PDF show p['date'] (closing date) for BF rows, not document_issue_date. Only the receipt print and the list use the receipt date. Check whether the register should also show the BF date.

ui_bugs.issue: document_issue_date ('YYYY-MM-DD') is formatted with dt(), so it shows a fake time ('23.10.2026, 00:00'). new Date('YYYY-MM-DD') is parsed as UTC, so in Romania it shows 03:00, and in UTC-negative timezones it would show the previous day. Use date() or a local date-only parse for document_issue_date.
fiscalReceiptDate is not reset to today after a successful save while Bon fiscal stays selected, so the next bon can silently keep the earlier historical date.

integration_issues.issue: Duplicate DI is accepted (backend bug above). There is no error toast and the list shows 2 identical DI rows.

issues: The kind column shows the raw value 'payment_order' / 'expense_settlement' instead of the Romanian label
The DP form uses the native date picker and number inputs; the native input type=date is used instead of the shadcn calendar

action_items: Fix the DI duplicate check in create_payment. Option 1: store document_issue_date=now().date() for dispozitie_incasare too. Option 2: change the $or to match document_issue_date in ['', missing] together with date ^document_day.
Add a unique index on (tenant_id, branch_id, doc_type, doc_number, document_issue_date) for payments, and on (kind, doc_number, day) for payment_order movements, to prevent race conditions
Render document_issue_date with date() and a local date-only parse, not dt(), in Cash.js and PrintDoc.js
Reset fiscalReceiptDate to today() after a successful save
Optional: show the BF receipt date in the range register and PDF, and translate the kind labels in the Plăți table
critical_code_review_comments: routes_finance.py has 774 lines, over the 700 limit. Move the cash code (payments, cash register, payouts, reversal, reports) to routes_cash.py
receipt_issue_date is only assigned inside the numerar branch. This works today because non-cash doc types skip the numbered path, but it is fragile. Initialise it before the branch.
The duplicate-check logic for BF/DI and DP is written twice in slightly different ways. Extract one helper keyed by (doc_type, doc_number, document_day).

rca of the issue: create_payment saves 'document_issue_date': '' for non-BF documents. The duplicate query's legacy fallback branch requires {document_issue_date: {$exists: false}}, so DI records created after this change (field present but empty) match neither branch, and duplicates go through. Repro: POST /api/payments twice with method=numerar, cash_document=collection_order, reference='3' on the same day; both return 200 with DI-000003.
